name: Work to Keep
summary: A portable portfolio identity that gives a reader a small, coherent sample they can revisit after a conversation.

palette.name: Background
palette.evidence: Native Office page/sheet white ground; explicit design choice retaining the reading surface.

palette.name: Text
palette.evidence: used style Normal explicit text color

palette.name: Case label slate
palette.evidence: Native reference.docx word/styles.xml: style PortfolioLabel; text.

recognitionRules: Use Baskerville project headings with Helvetica Neue explanatory copy.
Keep each case label close to its artifact.
Separate the sample, contribution and qualification in a compact reading order.
Use monochrome editorial structure so the work remains central.
Use slate-blue case labels above serif project titles; retain the two-column artifact/contribution arrangement.

principles: Name the work and the contribution before describing personal qualities.
Use the identity’s sample as a rhythm and vocabulary reference, not as a factual project claim.
voice.sample: A small sample, with enough context to read it again.
voice.sampleStatus: Original fictional brand copy authored for this guide, not a quotation or factual claim.
avoid: Avoid unsupported expertise labels and turning prototypes into shipped outcomes.
Avoid invented testimonials, performance claims and quotation attribution.
voice.secondaryExample: I made this part; the team decided what happened next.
voice.cadence: Short opening, concrete follow-through; vary sentence length for explanation.

logoDirection: Use WORK TO KEEP in Baskerville with a small Helvetica edition label. No folder or bookmark icon.
invariants: Use Baskerville project headings with Helvetica Neue explanatory copy.
Keep each case label close to its artifact.
Separate the sample, contribution and qualification in a compact reading order.
adaptations: A single-sheet edition can contain one complete case.
A longer leave-behind repeats the same case anatomy.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.

fonts.sourceFontDependency: Baskerville is a separately licensed/system font; not bundled.
Helvetica Neue is an Apple/system or separately licensed font; not bundled.

clearSpaceRule: Keep one half of the main wordmark cap height clear around the full silhouette, including its source-derived supporting device.

minimumSize.status: production minimum based on rendered 220/180px wordmark and 32/64px symbol inspection; verify again for unusual substrates
